source_context.item_title: Add overnight capability with the optional Aft Cabin, offering a comfortable sleeping space for two people. Large windows bring in natural light, creating an inviting retreat for weekend trips and extended cruising.

source_context.item_title: The optional u-sofa layout gives you the option to rearrange the back- and armrests to your liking, giving you more ways to lounge in between exploring.

images.scope_evidence: Tag DAM del modelo (ax29, ax29st, axopar, ins, mallorca, my24).

source_context.item_title: Upgrade the foredeck into a flexible lounge with the optional U‑sofa. It offers more seating and a comfortable place to relax, with the added possibility to convert the area into a sunbed. An optional foredeck table completes the space, creating a welcoming spot for social moments on the water.

images.title: Axopar 29 Sun-Top_Axopar shoot 16 May Mallorca DNG_DSCF6988-RAF
images.scope_evidence: Tag DAM del modelo (ax29, ax29st, axopar, ins, mallorca, my24).

source_context.item_title: The forward Multi Cabin adds valuable versatility by doubling as extra storage or a comfortable sleeping space. It can be equipped with a freshwater toilet and sink or configured as a full‑length cabin, allowing two adults or a small family to stay overnight with ease.
